standard.summary: 优化器快速预设方案：选择已调优的优化器 + 学习率 + beta 参数组合，无需手动配置每个参数。
standard.effect: 根据训练目标（稳定收敛/快速收敛/低显存）选择预设，自动填充 optimizer_type / optimizer_backend / weight_decay 等参数。optimizer_state_paging 将优化器状态（动量）分页卸载到 CPU，节省显存。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定优化器参数时使用预设作为起点；optimizer_state_paging 在 AdamW 优化器状态占用显著时（>2GB）且 CPU RAM 充足时开启。
standard.avoidWhen: 有精细调参需求时不使用预设（预设优先级低于手动设置）；state_paging 增加 CPU-GPU 数据交换开销，建议先用 AdamW8bit（原生省显存）。

standard_en.summary: Quick optimizer presets: pick a tuned combination of optimizer, learning rate and beta parameters instead of configuring each one by hand.
standard_en.effect: Choose a preset by training goal (steady convergence / fast convergence / low VRAM) and it fills in optimizer_type / optimizer_backend / weight_decay and the rest. optimizer_state_paging pages the optimizer state (the momenta) out to the CPU to save VRAM.
standard_en.whenToUse: Use a preset as a starting point when you are unsure of the optimizer parameters; turn optimizer_state_paging on when AdamW's optimizer state takes up a lot (>2GB) and CPU RAM is plentiful.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not use a preset when you need fine-grained tuning (a preset ranks below a manual setting); state_paging adds CPU-GPU exchange overhead, so try AdamW8bit first (it saves VRAM natively).

advanced.principle: optimizer_state_paging：将优化器动量 tensor（m/v）分页到 CPU，大于 min_tensor_mb 的 tensor 才分页（避免小 tensor 频繁传输）；pin_memory 使用 CPU 固定内存（page-locked），加速 GPU-CPU 传输。newbie_auto_swap_release 是新手模式特有的自动 block swap 管理（自动决定何时释放换出的 block）。
advanced.tradeoffs: optimizer_state_paging 的 pin_memory=True 会占用更多 CPU RAM（固定内存），但传输速度约快 2×；min_tensor_mb 设置过小会导致大量小 tensor 频繁传输（反而更慢）。

advanced_en.principle: optimizer_state_paging: pages optimizer momentum tensors (m/v) to CPU; only tensors larger than min_tensor_mb are paged (to avoid frequent small-tensor transfers); pin_memory uses page-locked CPU memory to speed up GPU-CPU transfers. newbie_auto_swap_release is the newbie-mode-specific automatic block swap manager (decides when to release swapped-out blocks).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: optimizer_state_paging with pin_memory=True consumes more CPU RAM (page-locked), but transfers are about 2x faster; setting min_tensor_mb too small causes many frequent small-tensor transfers (actually slower).
